none: PAS FindID 1011764: Gold Tremissis Coin Pendant
contea di ritrovamento: Kent (Inghilterra e Galles)

A complete gold coin pendant made from an early-medieval tremissis dating to the period c.AD 620-640. Description: Obverse: Diademed bust right, hatched body. Legend: from 7 o’clock, METTIS CIVETAT(I), s on side. Reverse: Cross with remnant of letters C and A in 3 rd and 4 th quarters, within circular border. Legend: + LEVDOALDVS m, starting at 5 o’clock anti-clockwise upside down.…
